content.name: Bracers of Archery
entries: While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the {@item longbow|SRD51} and {@item shortbow|SRD51}, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with such weapons.

content.name: Bracers of Archery
